newsitem.title: USA: HL&P says 234,000 in Houston without power.
newsitem.headline: HL&P says 234,000 in Houston without power.

text.p: Houston Lighting and Power Co (HL&P) raised the number of customers without electricity in the Houston area to 234,000 after a line of tornadic thunderstorms hit the area earlier Tuesday afternoon.
This was a sharp increase from an earlier estimate of 152,000 customers without power, an HL&P spokeswoman said.
A storm spawned at least three funnel clouds as it moved through Harris Country toward the southeast and the Gulf coast Tuesday.
The HL&P spokeswoman said it was not known if any major power transmission lines were damaged in the storm.
"We're trying to get a helicopter in the air to assess damage right now," the spokeswoman said.
